department: Department of Environmental Engineering & Earth Sciences (EEES)

deadline.value: No firm deadline; apply by January 15 to be considered for Fall assistantships.
deadline.quote: Apply by January 15th to be automatically considered for Fall assistantships

app_fee.value: The department says there is no application fee.
app_fee.quote: No Application Fee or GRE Required

fee_waiver.value: No application fee, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: No Application Fee or GRE Required

gre_general.value: The department does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: Applicants are not required to report GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: The department lists a TOEFL minimum of 90.
toefl_min.quote: we currently accept the following tests (minimum scores in parentheses): TOEFL (90), IELTS (7.0), PTE (61), or Duolingo (115)

ielts_min.value: The department lists an IELTS minimum of 7.0.
ielts_min.quote: we currently accept the following tests (minimum scores in parentheses): TOEFL (90), IELTS (7.0), PTE (61), or Duolingo (115)

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to be the research advisor before final admission.
supervisor.quote: The applicant must have a faculty member who has agreed to be the research advisor before final admission.

funding.value: Competition for assistantships is intense, so applying early is key.
funding.quote: Competition for assistantships is intense, so submitting your application early is crucial.

entry_route.value: Students with a bachelor's or master's in a related field may apply directly; most admitted students already hold an M.S.
entry_route.quote: Students with a baccalaureate or master’s degree in a related science or engineering field may apply directly to the Ph.D. EEES program.

also.quote: most students admitted to the Ph.D. program will have previously earned their M.S. degree

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Environmental Engineering and Earth Sciences PhD. Earth sciences is part of the programme name, so earth is listed as also_fields. Forest Resources and Plant and Environmental Sciences PhDs (CAFLS) also exist; they are not saved because this file takes the single environment slot.
